create_minibatch: create a MiniBatch instance with an image tensor, label, and optional multi-label one-hot encoding
build_dataset: build a Dataset NamedTuple with a builder function, task key, and optional number of examples
implement_datasetbuilderfn: implement a DatasetBuilderFn protocol that returns a tf.data.Dataset with shuffle, start, and end parameters
summarize_minibatch_repr: summarize the MiniBatch __repr__ method that formats image shape, label, and multi-label fields into a string
review_batch_repr: review the _batch_repr helper function that generates a human-readable string representation of a MiniBatch
